description: Defines configuration structs and parameters for a QoS-aware scheduler in a 5G/NR system, including policies for QoS, round-robin, power control, time advance, UE scheduling, system info, random access, and paging.

classes.name: time_qos_scheduler_config
classes.description: Configuration parameters for QoS-aware scheduler policy, including sub-weight combination, fairness, and priority settings.

classes.name: time_rr_scheduler_config
classes.description: Configuration parameters for round-robin scheduler policy (empty struct).

classes.name: scheduler_policy_config
classes.description: Variant type that can hold either QoS-aware or round-robin scheduler configuration.

classes.name: ul_power_control
classes.description: Configuration for uplink power control, including closed-loop control and bandwidth adaptation.

classes.name: scheduler_ta_control_config
classes.description: Parameters for Time Advance control loop, including measurement periods, thresholds, and outlier detection.

classes.name: scheduler_ue_expert_config
classes.description: UE scheduling parameters, including MCS ranges, HARQ retries, resource limits, and multiplexing options.

classes.name: scheduler_si_expert_config
classes.description: System Information broadcast configuration, including MCS indices and retransmission periods.

classes.name: scheduler_ra_expert_config
classes.description: Random access procedure parameters, including MCS indices and guardbands.

classes.name: scheduler_paging_expert_config
classes.description: Paging procedure parameters, including MCS index and retries.

classes.name: scheduler_expert_config
classes.description: Aggregated expert configuration including SI, RA, paging, UE, and diagnostic logging options.
